name: Fitness Classes: Strength and Conditioning
description:
Class Description: In this class you will learn foundational movements in the weight room coached by a strength and conditioning professional with a Master’s degree in Exercise Science. Classes will be designed and guided in a safe and effective manner to achieve desired goals, prevent injuries, feel comfortable in the weight room and have fun.

Fitness Classes are open to all students, staff and faculty! There is no need to sign up for the class, just arrive 5 minutes before the start of class and bring some water!

name: Fitness Classes: Tennis
description:
Class Description: This class is well suited for beginners and intermediate players who want to improve their tennis game overall. We usually work on fundamentals with feeding and hitting drills. We also try to emphasize learning in a fun supportive environment and incorporate match play whenever the students are able to rally and serve. If you need a tennis racquet stop by the Equipment Room, Gym 151 to rent one for the night. 

Fitness Classes are open to all students, staff and faculty! There is no need to sign up for the class, just arrive 5 minutes before the start of class and bring some water!

 If you have any other questions about Fitness Classes, feel free to email RecreationCenter@soka.edu
